s1.syndrome_frame: subacute onset of respiratory and systemic symptoms with pleural and pericardial effusions, lymphadenopathy, and lytic bone lesions
key_facts: bilateral pleural and pericardial effusions on chest radiograph and CT
lytic lesions in sternum, right humerus, and thoracic vertebrae

raw.syndrome_frame: subacute onset of respiratory and systemic symptoms with pleural and pericardial effusions, lymphadenopathy, and lytic bone lesions
key_facts: bilateral pleural and pericardial effusions on chest radiograph and CT
lytic lesions in sternum, right humerus, and thoracic vertebrae

shortlist.label: Serous ovarian cancer
shortlist.why_kept: elevated CA-125 and PET-CT findings suspicious for primary ovarian malignancy

shortlist.label: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: lymphadenopathy, pleural and pericardial effusions, and systemic symptoms

shortlist.label: Tuberculosis
shortlist.why_kept: systemic symptoms, pleural effusions, and lymphadenopathy

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: lymphadenopathy, pleural effusions, and systemic symptoms

raw.rationale: Elevated CA-125 level and PET-CT findings suspicious for primary ovarian malignancy, despite normal-sized ovaries on ultrasound, which can occur in early stages of ovarian cancer

rejected.label: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma
rejected.why: Lymphadenopathy and systemic symptoms could fit, but the specific PET-CT findings and elevated CA-125 are more suggestive of ovarian cancer

rejected.label: Multiple myeloma
rejected.why: Lytic bone lesions could suggest myeloma, but the presence of pleural and pericardial effusions and elevated CA-125 are not typical for myeloma

rejected.label: Tuberculosis
rejected.why: Chronic symptoms and systemic inflammation could fit, but the lack of fever, negative SARS-CoV-2 PCR, and specific imaging findings do not support TB

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: Systemic symptoms and lymphadenopathy could fit, but the presence of lytic bone lesions, pleural and pericardial effusions, and elevated CA-125 are not typical for sarcoidosis
